comments.author: Egw
comments.body: Does anybody know for sure how this "co-op" treasure hunt works? My case: I reached the clue that gives this quest, I have the search requirement but not the others. I have no theo at all. I fleeted with my friend who has both arch & theo at r11 or 12, he was next to me, I still can't take the quest. According to rumours, since 2nd age chapter 2, it should have worked.
